target_customer: Mobile game studios and their marketing teams
problem: Studios spend heavily on producing video ads and cannot easily learn which creative works.
business_model: B2B software and services sold in contracts, biggest customers at six figures
product_category: AI ad creative for games, later ad creative intelligence (Boa)

founders.name: Robert Huynh
education: Harvard Business School MBA (began after those roles)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he and his cofounder are serial founders with data science and generative AI backgrounds.

founders.name: Oscar Xing Luo
founders.background_notes: Named by a funding news search result; YC page gives first name Oscar only. The shutdown note is signed Robert, Oscar and Lee, Lee unidentified.

exit.reason: CEO Robert Huynh said AI advances let studios build creative tools in house, too few studios were big enough to sustain the business, and the company chose to close rather than shrink.

technical_complexity.rationale: Video ad generation and analysis built on third party generative models; the work was in templates, pipelines and later rewriting around fast improving foundation models.

defensibility.rationale: The company said the gap it sold into closed as foundation models improved and studios built tools in house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not an acquisition. The CEO attributed the shutdown to AI progress and customers building in house. Rival names come from undated aggregator comparison pages, so they are not listed as dated competitors.

market_need_then: Game studios spent heavily on user acquisition creative; the 2024 launch coverage said the product piloted with about a dozen partners.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, founder letter style shutdown note

branding.brand_signature: Boa, the late stage ad intelligence agent name

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press (PocketGamer.biz, Mobidictum, MobileMarketingMagazine) covered the seed and the shutdown, but no brand specific assets, community or merch were found.

pivots.to: AI video ads for mobile games
pivots.why: Described in seed round coverage as a focus after the raise.

pivots.to: Boa, an ad creative intelligence agent
pivots.why: Product Hunt era coverage says Boa no longer generates video; exact date not found.

outcome_analysis: Reforged Labs raised a 3.9 million dollar seed in August 2024 and counted large game publishers as customers, but shut down in August 2026. The CEO said the number of studios able to pay six figures was too small, foundation models eroded the value gap and studios built tools in house, and expansion beyond games and pivots did not gain traction. The company site confirms services ended July 2026.
notes: Directory status says Active but the company site and several outlets confirm shutdown in mid 2026; exit type is shutdown, conflict recorded here. One source dates the seed to 2025, treated as an error. Competitor list empty: only undated aggregator pages found. Customers named in coverage include Supercell, King, Ubisoft, Playtika and Scopely.
